verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents a Gazebo simulation tutorial (ros2-docs-16). Its topic-based abstraction for sensor data, name remapping and launch system make swapping sim for hardware plausible (ros2-docs-45, ros2-docs-31, ros2-docs-6), and a long-time user reports sim comes 'for free' if you follow ecosystem conventions (ros2-comm-9). No evidence explicitly documents running unchanged code on both simulation and the real robot. Missing for 10: explicit docs on sim-to-real code reuse (e.g. sim time handling or hardware abstraction layers), a worked example of switching between sim and hardware, and independent hands-on confirmation that no rewrite is needed.
